title: Relayed announce stores origin RX channel under immediate sender
description: In Node._process_announce(), announce.rx_channel is signed by and describes announce.originator_iid, but line 1186 stores it as _peer_rx_channel[sender.iid]. For a relayed announce, sender is the immediate relay and differs from the originator, so origin-controlled data is misbound to the relay. _peer_has_live_state then treats that stale/misbound entry as permanent eviction protection, and entries have no expiry. Store rendezvous channel under the authenticated identity it actually describes (or do not use relayed origin data for immediate-hop channel selection) and expire/remove it consistently; test direct vs relayed announces.
